notification.mail.verification.subject: Your Frappé code: {code}
notification.mail.verification.title: Activate your account
notification.mail.verification.body: Hi {name}. Type this code on the screen where you signed up.
notification.mail.verification.footer: If you did not create a Frappé account, ignore this email: without the code nobody can use it.
notification.mail.password_reset.subject: Code to change your password: {code}
notification.mail.password_reset.title: Change your password
notification.mail.password_reset.body: Use this code to choose a new password. Changing it signs you out of every session.
notification.mail.password_reset.footer: Didn’t ask for it? Your password stays the same and you can ignore this email.
notification.mail.email_change.subject: Code to confirm your new email: {code}
notification.mail.email_change.title: Confirm your new email
notification.mail.email_change.body: Until you confirm it, you keep signing in with your previous email.
notification.mail.email_change.footer: If you did not ask for this change, ignore this email and nothing happens.
